title: The Check Is in the Mail: Can Disclosure Reduce Late Payments to Suppliers?
authors: Elizabeth Chuk; Ben Lourie; Il Sun Yoo
eligible_reason: Single policy: the UK payment-practices reporting requirement (April 2017) for large UK buyers, with French and German buyers as controls. post = 1 for fiscal years beginning after April 2017, so onset differs across firms only through fiscal-year start month (same structure as mnsc.2024.04447, ASC 842). Every column estimates reghdfe y post##uk with tradingpairid (or firm) and fyear FE, so the post main effect enters as a separate time-varying regressor; all columns use entropy-balancing weights (ebalance uk ..., [pweight=_webal]) and most add time-varying buyer controls (lognetdue logpairage hhi logat marketshare logopercycle roa loss leverage ppne cash). Reweighting, extra post regressor, controls, and no shipped data.
design_notes: Replication_Code_STATA.do: Table 3 lines 37/39 (logpast on post##uk, with/without controls, if treat==1 [pweight=_webal]); Table 4 cross-sectional splits by rank1-rank4 and c.rankX## interactions; Table 5 suppliers; Tables on cash flow, leverage, investment, future profitability; post##treat (large vs small UK buyers) alternative control group; CAR event test around disclosure dates. Data: CreditRiskMonitor buyer-supplier-month payables (proprietary), Compustat Global, UK payment-practices portal. Samples built by Replication_Code_SAS.sas (not shipped outputs).
estimators_reported: reghdfe DiD with entropy-balancing weights (single policy date, fiscal-year-based onset)
n_adoption_cohorts_note: One policy date; post varies across firms only by fiscal-year start month.

specs.exclusion_reason: single policy date with fiscal-year-based post main effect as extra regressor; entropy-balancing weights (reweighting); data not shipped
specs.treatment_var: post x uk (post = FY begins after April 2017)
specs.unit_var: tradingpairid (buyer-supplier pair); assignment unit buyer firm
specs.controls: none in col 1; col 2 adds lognetdue logpairage hhi logat marketshare logopercycle roa loss leverage ppne cash

data_access: proprietary (CreditRiskMonitor; not shared per agreement with the DE; code only)
software: stata (reghdfe, ebalance); SAS for sample construction
screener_notes: No title/authors in the batch file; taken from 'README file.pdf'. Not in candidates.csv or the OpenAlex frame, so no abstract checked; year unknown.
